title: Takeover
paragraphs: “Uwah! He said it with a straight face! He really doesn’t understand what the problem is at all!”
“Naofumi-san, it’s Motoyasu.”
“…Oh, right. Motoyasu-kun has always been like this.”
Oh? Father is saying something similar to what the older sister mentioned before. Perhaps they are alike in some ways.
“What should we do? Should we just pin everything on Motoyasu and get out of this?”
“No, while it was ultimately Motoyasu-kun who did it, I don’t want to make excuses, and I don’t want to blame everything on him.”
“I see… Naofumi, you’re impressive.”
“Yeah, if it were me, I’d shift all the blame onto Motoyasu-san.”
Father gave a slight wry smile and then turned toward Fiancée and the Queen.
“Um… regarding your sister and father… I’m sorry.”
Fiancée looked troubled. The Queen placed a hand on her shoulder.
“Melty.”
“Yes… Mother.”
After looking at the Queen’s face, Fiancée quietly nodded.
“Regarding what happened earlier today… thank you for protecting me.”
“I-I’m just glad nothing serious happened.”
“Is Sakura-chan doing well?”
“Yeah. There are no lasting effects from her injuries, and she’s sleeping soundly… I’d like it if we could all get along with Sakura-chan and the others but… that’s probably impossible, huh?”
As Father muttered that, Fiancée shook her head. Of course. Even if the circumstances are different, she was chosen as Fiilo-tan’s Fiancée, after all.
“Heroes, please understand that Melty and I have no intention of holding you accountable for the killing of Aultcray.”
The Queen said this as she pulled Fiancée closer while keeping her hand on her shoulder.
“Huh? But…”
“The fault lies with Melromarc. Originally, the summoning of the Heroes was supposed to be conducted in order, starting with Faubrey, but our country broke that agreement and summoned you first.”
“Yeah, I remember Motoyasu-san mentioning that. The people from Faubrey also confirmed that story with us.”
Itsuki added. That’s exactly right. As Itsuki said, we had discussed this matter before.

“On top of that, just because of religious beliefs, they tried to falsely accuse Iwatani-sama, the Shield Hero, and then attempted to kill the other Heroes when they saw through the deception. Our country had no justification whatsoever. Even if they were killed, we have no right to complain.”
“B-but…”
“*Sigh*… Naofumi-san, if you hesitate too much, we’ll never move forward. We’ve already committed a crime. The only way to atone for it is to fight for the sake of the world.”
Oh? That’s quite a reasonable statement coming from Itsuki. It’s hard to believe this is the same Itsuki from before.
“Yeah, you’re right. The only thing we can do now is to be extra cautious with Motoyasu-kun…”
Father nodded at Itsuki’s words before turning to face the Queen.
“Aultcray should have been a hero, someone meant to protect and guide the people from the Waves… But instead, he used his wisdom in foolish ways and lost his life.”
Is the Queen holding back tears? Fiancée is looking down.

“In the end, wishing he had survived is just our selfishness. Right now, all we can do is hope that the Heroes will fight for the sake of the world. If I had the chance, I would have punished Aultcray myself and at least spared his life, but…”

As expected, the Queen is thinking practically. She may mourn the loss of that scum, but there’s no time for grief. Even while dealing with us, she doesn’t let any resentment show. She truly has the qualities of a ruler.

However… it seems the crimson swine has been completely forgotten. Well, the Queen never seemed very interested in her in the first place. Even Fiancée found her irritating. Since she was one of the main instigators of the problems, it’s only natural that she’s being treated as having gotten what she deserved.
“Um, then why did you call us here for this discussion?”
“Part of it is related to what Lady Seyaett told me, but there is also something I would like to ask of you Heroes, which is why I arranged this meeting.”
“…I understand. If there’s something we can do, we’ll do our best. At the very least, as a way to atone.”
As Father said this, he turned his gaze toward Fiancée.
“I’m sorry… To protect ourselves, we…”
“No, I understand… The Heroes didn’t kill Father and sister because they were bad people. Father and sister were the ones who tried to kill the Heroes and were simply defeated in return.”
Fiancée bowed her head toward Father.
“So please, don’t let it weigh on you and listen to what my mother has to say.”
“Alright. Then, Melty-chan.”
“Yes? What is it?”
“If you’re okay with it… please try to get along with Sakura-chan and the others. Those children have done nothing wrong, so don’t hesitate.”
“…Yes, I also ask that of you.”
“Yeah, thank you.”
After saying that, Fiancée moved to stand beside the Queen. It seems the Queen is about to entrust her with an important task.
“So, Queen, Eclair-san, you have something you need to ask of us, right?”
“Yes. It is a matter that heavily involves Lady Imiya as well. By tomorrow afternoon, the King of Faubrey will likely issue a decree regarding it as well.”
“And? It’s about Melromarc, right?”
“Indeed. Now, let me explain to you Heroes what is happening in Melromarc.”
The Queen exchanged glances with Éclair before beginning her explanation.
“Based on the testimonies of those from my faction who were in the castle, I will explain the situation to you Heroes…”

After we had taken down that scum and the crimson swine, we burned down the Church of the Three Heroes and rescued Éclair. This is what happened after that. The castle soldiers, having witnessed the terrifying power of the Heroes and suffering great losses, were confirming the whereabouts of that scum as they carried out their duties. Well, I blew him up, after all. There shouldn’t be a trace of him left. The church had been burned down in an instant, but as long as they could locate that scum, they still had some options. That was the situation, apparently. When the Queen revealed what had happened next, Father and the others were left in shock.
“That king survived!?”
“Impossible.”
“No way! We saw him take the attack right in front of us and get vaporized!”
“Ugh… just remembering it makes me feel sick.”
Father and the others reacted in their own ways, all equally stunned.
“T-Then… are you saying the king somehow survived?”
Father clung to a sliver of hope as he questioned the Queen. However, the Queen shook her head.
“Unfortunately, that is not the case.”
“Huh? But didn’t he survive?”
“Let me explain…”
As the Queen raised her hand, a pig suddenly appeared beside her. It must be one of the pigs from the shadows.
“Bu!”
“Now, transform into Melty.”
With that, the pig grabbed its clothing and took off a layer. To my eyes, it was still just a pig.
“T-Two Melty-chans!?”
“W-What is this…?”
Father and Itsuki exclaimed in shock at the sight. How strange… No matter how I look at it, it still looks like a pig to me.
“I see, so it was a body double.”
“Yes. A shadow operative disguised as the king and stabilized the situation.”
“Sigh… So then, what happened after that…?”
“That double was a follower of the Three Heroes Church.”
Oh? A memory of Father proving his innocence and forcing that scum and the crimson swine to apologize resurfaced in my mind.
What was it that scum said when the Queen arrived back then? He turned to the Queen, who had sided with Father…
‘N-No, that queen is an imposter! Seize her!’
That was it, wasn’t it? Basically, when things didn’t go his way, he assumed it was a body double. And now, the same thing had happened to him.

“Aultcray was certainly narrow-minded, but aside from his prejudice against demi-humans, he did act with the nation’s best interests in mind. Especially regarding faction disputes—he took care not to let the Three Heroes Church gain too much influence.”
“So… what happened when a fake king appeared?”
“To put it simply, the imposter had the nobles from my faction imprisoned and seized control of the country.”
“A coup…”
“Now that I think about it, the Queen was away on diplomatic missions, and the king who was supposed to protect the kingdom had died. In that situation…”
What!? So killing that scum at that point had such unintended consequences.

“I should have returned immediately to take command, but the Three Heroes Church acted skillfully. On the surface, they claimed that the Heroes had fled, making it seem as though the country’s security remained intact. However, behind the scenes, they ramped up the hunting of demi-humans.”
“Hmm, so that’s why the world feels even more dangerous than before.”
“Hey! Motoyasu! This is the first I’ve heard of this!”
Hmm? Ren is glaring at me. But no matter how he looks at me, I’m not scared in the slightest.
